description: Use when you need a block header on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: latest or a given number, with hash, parent, timestamp, miner, gas used/limit. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/block, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Block header only; for one transaction use evm_transaction or evm_receipt. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

number.description: Decimal or 0x-hex block number, or latest (default); a block the node does not have yet is refused before any charge
